name: Ellis McGaskin
strengths: McGaskin diagnoses quickly and fits downhill with disciplined gap integrity.
McGaskin finishes tackles with contact balance and leg drive, creating splash at or behind the LOS.
McGaskin shows sideline-to-sideline range with sound angles despite not being a pure burner.
McGaskin times blitzes well, navigates traffic, and uses violent hands to generate QB pressure.
weaknesses: McGaskin's sub-6-foot frame can get stressed covering bigger tight ends down the seam in traditional MIKE.
comparison: McGaskin comps to Lavonte David -- compact, instinctive off-ball linebacker who plays bigger than the listing with finishing violence (size-matched to McGaskin's 5-11.5 / 210 mold).
projection: McGaskin projects as develop into the LB room, earn early special-teams and package snaps, then compete for a WILL/run-fit starting role -- starter upside as a downhill processor and situational blitzer.
schemeFit: McGaskin fits White as a WILL/Star hybrid who fits run and blitzes cleanly.
